newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse trading halted by technical trouble.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse trading halted by technical trouble.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) stopped trading in early session on Friday on account of technical problems, traders said.
"They (officials) said it was because of a technical problem but there were no specifics. They did not say if trading would resume," said Henry Ong, trader at Sapphire Securities.
There was no official statement from the exchange and bourse officials were not available for comment.
